Prof.Dr.EjazAhmad
Dr.Ejaz Ahmed is working in the capacity of Associate Professor/Head of Physics Department in
IMCBF-8/4Islamabad.Hehasverysoundacademicandadministrativeexperiencerangingfor27
years. His qualifications of Ph.D. (Physics), M.Sc. (Mathematics) and PGD reflect his dynamic
academicvision.Duringhis Professional Careerheserved invarious institutions(IMCBs,PAFiC

B.S levels and actively participated in Career Counselling Programs for defining the practical
demonstrative path for students of different institutions, as future professionals of national and
international universities. He also focused on the development of booklets regarding topics of
Physics,based on McQs,short questions and workedon descriptive conceptualunderstanding of
